test_move_absolute: test the MoveAbsoluteTest class to verify robot forward, right, left, and coordinate movement commands
test_move_ref_objects: test the MoveRefObjectsTest class to verify robot navigation to and between referenced objects like cubes
test_turn: test the TurnTest class to verify robot left and right turn commands with 90 degree yaw changes
test_stop: test the stop command in MoveAbsoluteTest to verify an in-progress move halts before reaching the target
test_action_sequence_order: test sequential multi-coordinate movement commands to verify the agent visits waypoints in order
